function.arguments:
{"command": "cd units
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, importlib
sys.path.insert(0,'csvfix'); import impl as csv_impl
sys.path.insert(0,'rules');   import engine
sys.path.insert(0,'ledger');  import ledger as lg
sys.path.insert(0,'schedule');import schedule as sch
sys.path.insert(0,'intervals');import intervals as iv
sys.path.insert(0,'flags');   import flags as fl

# csvfix edges
print("csv quoted:", csv_impl.parse('"a,b", 2, x'))
print("csv 4col:", csv_impl.parse('a,b,c,d'))
print("csv 2col:", csv_impl.parse('a,2'))
try: csv_impl.total([["a","1","x"]])
except ValueError as e: print("csv bad ->", type(e).__name__)
print("csv blank:", csv_impl.total([["a","1",""],["b","2","3"]]))

# rules edges
print("all []:", engine.evaluate({"all":[]}, {}), "any []:", engine.evaluate({"any":[]}, {}))
print("missing key:", engine.evaluate({"all":["zzz"]}, {"a":True}))
try: engine.evaluate({"xor":["a"]}, {})
except ValueError as e: print("rules unknown ->", type(e).__name__)

# ledger edges
L=lg.Ledger()
print("empty acct:", L.apply([("deposit","a",1)],"b"), lg.balance([], "a"))
try: L.apply([("withdraw","b",-5)],"a")
except ValueError as e: print("ledger neg(other acct) ->", type(e).__name__)
try: L.apply([("mystery","a",1)],"a")
except ValueError as e: print("ledger badkind ->", type(e).__name__)

# schedule edges
print("sch empty:", sch.slots([],1))
print("sch merge nested:", sch.slots([(0,100),(10,20)],5))
print("sch touch thr:", sch.slots([(0,10),(40,50)],30))
print("ovl touch:", sch.overlaps((0,10),(10,20)), "ovl pt:", sch.overlaps((5,5),(0,10)))

# intervals edges
I=iv.Impl()
print("iv merge default join:", I.merge([[0,0],[1,1]]))
print("iv subtract disjoint:", I.subtract([[0,1],[10,11]],(5,5)))
print("iv total overlap:", I.total_length([[0,10],[5,20]]))
print("iv total empty:", I.total_length([]))

# flags edges
print("flags dashdash:", fl.Impl().parse(["--","-x","--y"]))
print("flags k=v:", fl.Impl().parse(["--k=","-k=v"]))
print("flags short value-ish:", fl.Impl().parse(["--k","-abc"]))
print("flags empty:", fl.Impl().parse([]))
PY"}
